authorship: Hand-authored requirement traces over docs/X1_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT.md; the emitter only expands sequential case-ID ranges. No production transport code exists or was consulted.
reciprocityLaw: Every trace names at least one existing case; every case and mutation control belongs to at least one trace; every evidence owner is a named future test file or the human listening directory.

traces.requirement: Authoritative locked/ready/playing/paused/interrupted/fault/disposed machine with serialized, non-overlapping transitions and exhaustive cell outcomes.
Strict FIFO command admission with monotonic request IDs, a 32-command queue bound, and total refusal precedence.
Generation-checked 25 ms/100 ms lookahead scheduling against the audio clock with one schedule per event, bounded lead, and display-only animation frames.
Exact rational beat-to-second mapping, P0 gate law passthrough, the frozen audio-envelope floor, and tempo-change epoch beat preservation.
traces.parentSource: X1 required implementation and REBUILD_PLAN 13.8 and 13.10

traces.requirement: Stop awaits zero possible future attack in frozen eight-step order, returns to the run start beat, and survives one hundred rapid cycles on one graph.
Playing a chart schedules every plan event exactly once; silence is legal only for an exactly empty timeline.
Pause records the exact old-epoch beat, resume re-anchors there, and seek retires-then-republishes the prior status inside plan bounds.
Tempo changes retire only the unsounded horizon at a new epoch with revision-checked bindings; loops validate ranges and wrap through a loop-wrap generation boundary.
Serialized instrument changes cancel and reschedule only not-yet-attacked horizon voices with exact validation of the five domain IDs.
Count-in and metronome clicks are generated transport events with the frozen click policy, reserved IDs, and the one persistent graph.
traces.parentSource: X1 required implementation, REBUILD_PLAN 13.10, and the reviewed X0 topology authority

traces.requirement: Preview commands own X0 preview voices under reserved IDs, release predecessors first, and never touch progression transport state.
Natural end publishes ready at the run start beat with the eight-second tail deadline; replay during a residual tail retires the old generation first.
Browser interruption freezes musical time, projects paused with the stable code, and recovery re-anchors at the stored beat via a trusted gesture.
Import/New replacement retires progression and preview voices before publishing the replacement binding; null bindings empty the transport.

traces.requirement: The legacy whole-chart undefined-chord silence class cannot recur: every playable chart sounds, and silence requires an exactly empty timeline.
The legacy callbacks-attack-after-Stop class cannot recur: zero post-stop attacks across one hundred stress cycles.
The legacy inert BPM/scrubber/duration class cannot recur: tempo, seek, and loop changes have exact audible plan effects.
The legacy init and rapid-instrument race class cannot recur: serialized commands and horizon reschedules leave no stale attack or stuck voice.

A groove change during playback re-performs the running plan at the next unstarted event without stopping, losing the playhead, or touching sounding voices; a stale or mismatched binding refuses without touching the running epoch.
